name: Fiesta Grove RV Resort
note: 55+ RV and mobile-home resort community in Palmetto, mostly seasonal; daily stays alongside weekly, monthly, 3-4 month and annual. --Claude  AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+ ('the ideal 55+ RV and Mobile Home resort community'; fiestagroverv.com, 2026-10-12). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Rates page (latest seasons posted: 2024-25 winter season Nov 1 - Apr 30 and summer May 1 - Oct 31, 2025): RV site daily $100 in season, $70 in summer; overflow camping (water and electric, no sewer) daily $62 in season, $50 in summer. Weekly, monthly, 3- and 4-month and annual rates too. Lock-site fee $35 (otherwise management may shift reserved sites); $25 cancellation fee, deposit refunds shrink inside 60 days.

name: Lake Eufaula Campground
note: Campground on W Chewalla Creek Dr in Eufaula with pull-through overnight RV sites, tent sites, a pool and mini golf. 30- and 50-amp sites; a one-time $5 processing fee (2026); long-term sites are a separate section. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Lake Eufaula Campground: 30- and 50-amp full hookups $35 a night plus 10% tax; one-time $5 processing fee per reservation. Read 2026-10-15.

name: Lake Capote Recreation Area
note: Southern Ute Indian Tribe recreation area on CO-151 south of Pagosa Springs, run by the tribe's Division of Wildlife around a stocked fishing lake; no Colorado fishing license needed, but a daily lake permit is. Tribal rangers patrol; no alcohol or firearms. --Claude

field_notes.Season: 2026 schedule: March 5-29 open Thursday to Sunday only (campers stay Thursday to Saturday nights and leave by Sunday afternoon); March 30 - October 27 open daily; closed for the season October 28. No water in the campground in March or October.
field_notes.Booking: Book online on the operator's ResNexus page by the day before arrival; same day, call 970-883-2273 or ask at the bait shop (8 a.m.-6 p.m.). After hours an open site has a permit on the board outside the store and can be self-registered, for one night only. All visitors check in at the bait shop. Cancel 3+ days ahead for a 90% refund.
field_notes.Fees: 2026 general-public rates: RV site $25 a day or $150 a week; tent site $18 ($108 weekly). Southern Ute tribal members pay less with a SUIT ID. Day use is $5 per car per day for non-members (the page does not say whether campers pay it). A daily lake fishing permit ($10 adult) is needed only to fish.
field_notes.Sites: 10 RV sites and 30 tent sites; two vehicles and eight people per site.

name: Iola Pines Campground
note: Wooded campground by the golf course in Iola: water/30-amp sites, full hookup (40 ft and 80 ft, 50-amp), cabins. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Water + 30-amp $45, full hookup 40 ft $50, full hookup 80 ft 50-amp $57 per night; holiday rates (3-night minimum) $55-67.

name: Whispering Maples Campground
note: Small family campground under trees on a farmstead northwest of Wapello, just off US 61, with a small pond to the west. Formerly Papa's Paradise; new owners in 2026. No website; call ahead. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $25 a night in September 2026 (RV Life). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: an RV Life reviewer paid $25 a night for a full-hookup pull-through in September 2026, no discount. The operator has no web page.

name: Beaver Crossing Park Campground
note: Village of Beaver Crossing campground in the town park, entered at 1025 Elk St by the baseball field and playground. Electric and water (water in the warm months) at the RV sites; pay in the box at the entrance or at the village clerk's office. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Suggested donation $10 a night, left in the box near the entrance or the outside payment slot at the Village Clerk's office. Village of Beaver Crossing page, read 2026-11-04.

name: Wilson RV Park
note: Small grass-site park in the town of Wilson (821 27th St), 5 minutes off I-70 exit 206, a short walk to downtown and a few miles from Wilson Lake. Standard sites have water and electric on the passenger side (a 25-50 ft hose and cord); preferred sites have them on the driver's side; premium sites 8 and 9 are 164-ft pull-throughs. Owners live next door; no staffed office. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Winter season November 1 through February is limited service.
field_notes.Booking: Book online (ResNexus; the operator calls it the best pricing), by phone, or on arrival at the self-check-in in the laundry room, checking availability before hooking up.
field_notes.Fees: ResNexus quote for Friday 6 November 2026, one night: standard back-in full-service $38, standard and preferred $40-42, the two 164-ft premium pull-throughs (sites 8 and 9) $58. A guaranteed pull-through Oct-Apr is a $10 one-time charge. Rates include up to 6 adults. Read 2026-11-06.

name: Hillside RV Park
note: Small owner-run park on US 59 at the south edge of Oswego (1108 S Commercial St): a section of long back-to-back pull-through sites with full hookups and WiFi, beside a block of mobile homes and long-term trailers. No restrooms, showers or laundry; self-contained rigs only. Grocery and Dollar General within walking distance. No website (its old domain is for sale); call. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $20 a night in June 2026. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $20 a night paid in June 2026 (RV Life); $18 in 2023-2026 with Passport America or Good Sam. The operator has no web page; call to confirm.

name: Rock Island RV Park
note: Small private park at 401 Campbell Ave, two blocks off Clyde's main street; gravel pull-throughs around a bath house, walking trail and garden. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $23 a night in August 2026 and $40 for a full hookup in September 2024 (RV Life reviews); the park has no web page (2026-11-05). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Camper-reported: $23 a night in August 2026 and $40 for a 50-amp full hookup in September 2024 (RV Life reviews); the park has no web page.

name: Vanocker Campground and RV Park
note: Small campground on the south edge of Sturgis bordering the Black Hills NF (1214 Pineview Dr), open all summer with roll-ins welcome. Full-hookup RV sites, 30/50-amp electric sites with water fill (dump on site), tent sites, dry cabins; wifi, laundry, shower house. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Full hookup $59/night, 30/50-amp dry (water fill, dump on site) $49/night for 2 adults; Sturgis Rally packages extra.

name: Spring Creek Campground
note: Small rural campground around a pond at 492 County Rd 100 N, Montrose, a couple of miles off I-70: level gravel sites, most electric-only (some 50-amp) with water at shared hydrants, dump station on the way out. Operator has no website beyond Facebook; call. Camper-reported rate: $25 a night (Campendium, 2024-2025, and an RV Life review, August 2026). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Campendium reviewers paid $25 a night from March 2024 through September 2025; an RV Life review gave the same in August 2026.

name: Lum Park RV Campground
note: City of Brainerd campground in Lum Park on Rice Lake (1619 NE Washington St): 30/50-amp electric and water sites, free Wi-Fi, fire rings, dump station. Open May 1-Oct 31; $45 for 65+/military/veterans, off-season in October and April (electric only). No tents and no weekly-or-longer seasonal rates. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Standard $55/day (65+/military/veteran $45); weekly $330; October and April off-season $25 (electric only).

name: Mundo Hot Springs
note: Hot-springs pool, cafe and campground on Upper Goodrich Creek Rd outside Cambridge, half a mile off the Weiser River Trail. Full-hookup RV sites (50/30A), water+power sites, tents $20; a $5/person soak for campers. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Mundo Hot Springs: full hookups (30/50-amp) $40 a night, power and water $35; tents $20; campers soak for $5. Read 2026-10-15.

name: Provo River Resort
note: RV park and cabins on a bend of the Provo River at 8833 S Old US Hwy 189 in Provo Canyon below Deer Creek Dam; water and electric (no sewer hookups), back-in sites on Campspot, riverfront double sites. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Provo River Resort's Campspot engine, one night Oct 20-21 2026: site types priced in their names - back-in sites $30, $40, $60 and $70, premium back-in and pull-through $80, riverfront $120-190; Campspot adds about $8 plus 3% in fees. Water and electric, no sewer hookups.

name: San Ygnacio RV Park
note: RV park (~50 sites) on US-83 at San Ygnacio near Falcon Lake; daily for up to 2 people including electric, weekly/monthly lots too. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Daily rate $30 for up to 2 people including water, electric and WiFi; weekly $150.

name: K & K RV Park
note: Small RV park at 200 W 12th St, Shamrock, near I-40; no website - book by phone. Camper-reported rate: $15 a night (Campendium, October 2025 and July 2026). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Campendium reviewers paid $15 a night in October 2025 and July 2026.

name: Cedar Grove RV Park & Campground
note: RV park and campground at 187 US-84, Fairfield; pull-through or back-in 50 amp, $140/week (2026). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: $40/night pull-through or back-in (50 amp), $140/week.

name: 1485 E RV Park
note: RV park at 24016 FM 1485 E, New Caney; nightly 30 amp or 50 amp, weekly $150-175 (2026). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Nightly $40 or $50 (30/50 amp), weekly $150-175.

name: The Scuba Ranch
note: Dive park on a quarry lake at 8131 County Rd 346, Terrell, with grassy back-in RV spaces (30/50 amp, water). --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights (Minimum two-night stay required on RV spaces.; www.thescubaranch.com, 2026-10-10). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Minimum two-night stay required on RV spaces. Kept with the minimum marked, per AWH 2026-10-10.
field_notes.Fees: RV spaces (30/50-amp electric + water) $40+/night, one dump included; minimum two-night stay.

name: Meadview RV Park & Cozy Cabins
note: RV park with cabins at 28100 Pierce Ferry Rd, Meadview (on the road to Lake Mead's Pearce Ferry and Grand Canyon West); full-hookup back-in sites, 30-amp or 30/50-amp (ResNexus). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Full-hookup 30-amp $47, 30/50-amp $50 per night (ResNexus, October 2026). From our own note (entry added 2026-10-05); not re-confirmed with the operator as of 2026-10-11.

name: Encore Tranquility Lakes RV Resort
note: Newer Encore (ELS) resort on Burnt Store Rd, northwest Cape Coral, built around a 90-acre lake; sites ring the shore. RVs over 10 years old need management approval. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Booked online through Thousand Trails' NewBook engine or the Reservation Department. 'Single night midweek campsite reservations may be booked.' RVs more than 10 years old must be pre-approved by management. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Deposit of one night's rate; RV stays of 1-27 days fully refundable up to 2 days before arrival.
field_notes.Fees: Encore Tranquility Lakes booking engine, one night: full-hookup pull-in and back-in sites $114 (Nov 10 2026) and $120 (Jan 12 2027); on the 2026-10-11 read the deluxe lakefront back-in was $136 and lakefront $147 (Nov 10 2026), not offered for these dates on 2026-10-21. Weekly rates lower (7-night minimum). Rates exclude service fees; a per-day guest fee applies over six guests.
field_notes.Sites: Concrete pads; both pull-in and back-in full-hookup site types.

name: Fisher's Landing Resort
note: Marina resort on Martinez Lake (Colorado River backwater) north of Yuma. Dry camping 2 weeks $75 or $150/month for 2 people; pay at the Camp Rental Office. No marked pads: campers spread out across open desert above the marina, most parked by a shade tree, with roomy, private spacing. Restrooms nearby; general store sells firewood. --Claude

Fees: +$10/night each adult over 2, children 12 and under free

field_notes.Fees: Dry camping $10 per person per day (2 people = $20), 12 and under free; 2 weeks $75.

name: Bunker's Resort (Williams Lake)
note: Fishing resort on Williams Lake south of Cheney: water/electric RV sites, lakeside full hookups, dry camping (20A, 35-ft max); boat launch and moorage included. Two-night minimum, one night when available. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights, 3 on holidays; one night when available (bunkersresort.com, 2026-10-12). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: 2-night minimum, 3 on holidays; one night when available (operator's rates page).
field_notes.Fees: Lakeside full hookup $60, water & electric $45, dry camping $35 per night; 2-night minimum (1 night when available), 3 on holidays.

name: Cassel Campground (PG&E)
note: FCFS and reservable sites in pines near Hat Creek (fly fishing) at Cassel, east of Burney. PG&E reservation system 2026-27: pads 35-60 ft. --Claude  Reservations need at least 2 nights; first-come, first-served sites can be taken for one night (PG&E, 2026-10-10). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Reservations need at least 2 nights (max 14) and can't be made within 3 days of arrival; reservations for the season open April 15. Some sites are first-come, first-served, and those can be taken for a single night. Kept per AWH 2026-10-10: the FCFS sites mean a one-night stay is possible.
field_notes.Fees: PG&E reservation site, July 6-8 2027 search (2-night 'Use Fee' halved; 3-night check at Lake McCumber confirmed it is the stay total). $20/night, all sites. Other fees and taxes may apply; cancellation $15 per site.

name: Cool Springs Campground (PG&E)
note: On the east shore of Butt Valley Reservoir (PG&E), Plumas County; 5 mph boating. PG&E reservation system 2026-27: pads 20-35 ft. --Claude  Road work on Butt-Prattville Road near Cool Springs, Ray Adams Boat Launch and Ponderosa Flat from Aug 10, 2026 through the rest of the 2026 season: traffic delays, heavy trucks, noise and dust (PG&E notice, 2026-10-10). --Claude  Reservations need at least 2 nights; first-come, first-served sites can be taken for one night (PG&E, 2026-10-10). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Reservations need at least 2 nights (max 14) and can't be made within 3 days of arrival; reservations for the season open April 15. Some sites are first-come, first-served, and those can be taken for a single night. Kept per AWH 2026-10-10: the FCFS sites mean a one-night stay is possible.
field_notes.Fees: PG&E reservation site, July 6-8 2027 search (2-night 'Use Fee' halved; 3-night check at Lake McCumber confirmed it is the stay total). $25/night, all sites (most limited to 25 ft). Other fees and taxes may apply; cancellation $15 per site.
